inputs.text: [excited] Twenty-five feet long — [amazed] as long as two cars, one behind the other. Standing up, six feet tall — [curious] as tall as Dad standing up. And six thousand kilos — [proud] as heavy as THREE rhinos. [calm] It wasn't fast at all: only about 4 miles an hour, like Dad walking fast.
[confident] Nope. [serious] It didn't need to be — its armor did the job.
